correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 legal swaps among positions 1,..,n on the cycle, the side-of-home signature L subset {2,..,n-1} is preserved by linear neighboring swaps; canonical two-block sorting legally connects each sector. The wrap swap replaces one early internal label by one late internal label, preserving |L|=exc-1. The canonical form begins at min L and ends at max complement, giving a strictly increasing signature-sum move until the largest-|L| signature is reached. Thus each fixed excedance is one component. Inclusion-exclusion gives its known Eulerian derangement size; the two extreme cyclic shifts are isolated. Direct independent graph construction enumerated all n=3..7 and checked exact components, statistics and isolated states.
